description:
## What's New in v6.3.0

		### Agent Path Per-Call Request Context
		- RunAgentAsync(string, int, AIRequestContext?) and RunAgentStreamAsync(string, int, StreamOptions?, AIRequestContext?, CancellationToken) now accept AIRequestContext.
		- Context flows through AsyncLocal and is safe for concurrent agent runs on the same service.

		### AIService.SystemMessageProvider for Automatic Context Injection
		- New Func<CancellationToken, ValueTask<AIRequestContext?>>? property invoked automatically before every outbound call (GetCompletionAsync, StreamAsync, RunAgentAsync, RunAgentStreamAsync).
		- Register once at service construction; callers no longer need to build and pass AIRequestContext at every entry point.
		- Async-shaped signature — providers that need IO (database, cache, HTTP) run natively without blocking on .Result/.GetAwaiter().GetResult(). Streaming paths forward the caller's CancellationToken; non-streaming paths pass CancellationToken.None.
		- When an explicit per-call context is also supplied, the two merge field-by-field: explicit wins on scalar fields; AdditionalMessages concatenates.
		- Two fluent overloads resolved by lambda arity: service.WithSystemMessageProvider(() => ctx) for sync, service.WithSystemMessageProvider(async ct => ctx) for async. Property exposes internal set so fluent helpers are the canonical assignment path.

		### Fixed: AIRequestContext.SystemMessagePrefix / SystemMessageSuffix Now Apply
		- Previously declared since v5.0.0 but never consumed by any provider. GetEffectiveSystemMessage() now composes prefix + summary + base + suffix in that order.
		- Purely additive behavior: callers that never set these fields see identical output.

		Requires Mythosia.AI.Abstractions v2.1.0.

		---

		## Documentation
		- Basic Usage: https://github.com/AJ-comp/Mythosia.AI/wiki
		- Advanced Features: https://github.com/AJ-comp/Mythosia.AI/wiki/Advanced-Features
		- Release Notes: https://github.com/AJ-comp/Mythosia.AI/wiki/Release-Notes
		- GitHub: https://github.com/AJ-comp/Mythosia.AI
releaseNotes: v6.3.0: RunAgentAsync/RunAgentStreamAsync now accept an optional AIRequestContext for per-call system message prefix/suffix and request-scoped composition. New AIService.SystemMessageProvider (Func<CancellationToken, ValueTask<AIRequestContext?>>?) auto-injects a baseline context on every outbound call (including agent paths); async-shaped so provider-side IO does not need .Result blocking. Two fluent overloads (WithSystemMessageProvider) resolve sync/async by lambda arity. Explicit per-call contexts merge field-by-field on top. Fixes dormant AIRequestContext.SystemMessagePrefix / SystemMessageSuffix (declared since v5.0.0 but never consumed) — GetEffectiveSystemMessage() now composes prefix + summary + base + suffix. Additive; existing callers unaffected. Requires Mythosia.AI.Abstractions v2.1.0.
